headline: Do you know who from the Balkans has now 'stabbed an ally in the back'? It's no secret... Bulgaria!
summary: Bulgaria has said no to new European financing, according to the Alo report, which frames the decision as a break with its EU partners.
why: EU financing decisions affect member-state budgets, borrowing costs and the bloc's fiscal coordination, which matter for European bond and currency markets.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Znate ko je sa Balkana sada "zario nož u leđa" savezniku? Nije tajna... Bugarska!
